book.name: Jon
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Jon Le Rorori

content: Utu i tabo na lolo
Va i rikowe Utu kaerova inawe, na Utuko iyako va weiye Loi, na Utuko iye Loi.
Ma vamba i vakatha yambaneke Utuko iyako vama inawe, weiye Loi.
Loi va i vakaiwoŋa Utu na i vakatha bigibigike wolaghɨye. Mava i vakatha bigi regha na ma weiye Utu.
Yawalɨ rɨghethora amalaghɨniye, na yawalɨke iyake gharɨgharɨ lenji manjamanjala.
Manjamanjalake iyake i woya e momouwo, ko momouwo ma valɨkaiwae i vun.
Loi va i variya amala regha idae Jon.
Va i mena na i utuŋa manjamanjalako iyako utuniye, mbala gharɨgharɨ thɨ loŋwe utuko iyako na thɨ loŋweghathɨ.
Iye ma i womena manjamanjala weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ, nandere, mbema i mena i utuŋa eŋge manjamanjalako utuniye weŋgi.
Iyake manjamanjala emunjoru, manjamanjalaniye i mena e yambaneke na i giya manjamanjala weŋgiya gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye.
Va ina e yambaneke, na othembe va i vakatha yambaneke, yambaneke mava i ghareghare.
Va i mena i yaku e ghambae, ko iyemaeŋge ghambae gharɨgharɨniye mava thɨ kulavatha.
Ko iyemaeŋge taulaghɨko iya thavala thɨ vaŋguvatha na thɨ loŋweghathɨ, i vakathaŋgi na valɨkaiwanji thɨ tabo Loi le ŋgaŋga.

Mava thɨ tabo na Loi le ŋgamaŋgama ŋgoreiya gharɨgharɨ ghinda ra vwara e mbunɨma na madibe, ŋgoreiya raŋa thɨ virɨ e yambaneke gamagaiŋgi na e ramaramanji. Ko iyake Loi ghamberegha i vakathaŋgi na le ŋgaŋga.

Utu kaero i tabo na lolo, gharethovu na Loi ghaghareghare emunjoru i riyevanjara na i mena i yaku weinda. Wo thuwe le vwenyevwenye na Ramae va i vakatha na ghamba rerenuwaŋa kaiwae nariye mbe ghamberegha eŋge ŋgama ghedighedi.

Jon va i utuŋa amalaghɨniye utuniye. I kula na iŋa, “Loloke iyake iya utuniya va yaŋama, ‘Loloko iya i rereghamba e ghereiŋguko iye i laghɨye kivwalaŋgo kaiwae amalaghɨniye vama inawe amba muyai ghino.’”
Kaiwae ghare weinda, mbema i thovuye moli vara weinda, iya kaiwae le giya bwagabwaga ma i motomoto.
Loi va i giya Mbaro weya Mosese amba Mosese i giya weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ, ko iyemaeŋge Loi le gharethovu na ghaghareghare emunjoru i mena we Jisas Krais.

Ma lolo regha i thuwathuwa weya Loi. Nariye mbe ghamberegha eŋge ŋgama ghedighedi, kaiwae iye mboromboro weiye Loi na iye ina Ramae ele valɨvaŋga, ee, iye i woraŋgiya weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ ŋgoroŋga Loi ghaghareghare.
Jon Rabapɨtaiso le vavaghare
Iyake Jon ghalɨŋae mbaŋa Jiu lenji randeviva thɨ variyeŋgiya ravowovowo vavana weinjiyaŋgiya na ghanjirathalavu vavana na vethɨ vaito Jon thɨŋa, “Thela ghen?”
Mava i wothuwele bigi regha weŋgi, i uturaŋgiya bigibigike wolaghɨye weŋgi iŋa, “Emunjoru, ma Mesaiya ghino.”
Thɨ vaito thɨŋa, “Ko thela eŋge ghen? Ilaija ghen?” Jon i gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Nandere, ma Ilaija ghino.” “Loi ghalɨŋaema gharauta ghen?” I gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Nandere.”
Thɨ dagewe thɨŋa, “Ko thela eŋge ghen? Nuwameiya wo wonjogha na wo giya thombe thovuye weŋgiya thavala methɨ variyeime. Ŋgoroŋga uŋa ghen kaiwan?”
Jon i gonjogha weŋgi, i vathiya Loi ghalɨŋae gharautu, Aiseya le utu, iya iŋake, “Ghino ghalɨŋaŋgu ŋgoreiya lolo regha ghalɨŋae i kulakula e njamnjam: ‘U varumwara kamwathɨ Giya kaiwae.’”
Ravandavandaŋama Parisima va thɨ variyeŋgi,
thɨ vaito Jon thɨŋa, “Thoŋgo ma Mesaiya ghen, o Ilaija, o Loi ghalɨŋaema gharautu, buda kaiwae eŋge u bapɨtaiso?”
Jon i gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Ya bapɨtaisoŋgiya gharɨgharɨ e mbwa, ko lolo regha ina e tɨnemina i ndeghathɨ, iye ma hu ghareghare,
iye i rereghamba e ghino. Ko iyemaeŋge ghino ma elo thovuye na valɨkaiwaŋgu ne ya raka gheghe ghae.”
Bigibigike wolaghɨye thiyake va thɨ yomara Betani e Walaghɨta Jorɨdan valɨghadidiye i vorovoro, iya Jon va i bapɨbapɨtaisoŋgiya gharɨgharɨkowe.
Jisas iye ne i thavwiyathu yambaneke gharɨgharɨniye lenji tharɨ
Mbaŋambaŋa vena Jon i thuwe Jisas i loŋga menawe, amba iŋa, “Wo hu thuwe, iyako Loi le Sip Nariye na iye i thavwiyatha yambaneke lenji tharɨ.
Iyake iyava ya utuuta utuniyema, iyava yaŋama, ‘Lolo regha iya i menamenako, i rereghamba e ghino, ko iyemaeŋge iye i laghɨye kivwalaŋgo kaiwae vama inawe amba ghino ya virɨ.’
Ghino womberegha mava ya ghareghare, ko ghino ya mena ya bapɨtaisoŋga e mbwa. Ya vakatha iyake na mbala Isirel gharɨgharɨniye thɨ ghareghare thela amalaghɨniye.”
Jon i uturaŋgiya wagiyawe iŋa, “Ya thuwe Une i njama e buruburu ŋgoreiya bunebune na i yaku Jisas e vwatae.

Ma mbalava ya ghareghare, ko Loi, iya va i variyeŋgo na ya bapɨtaiso e mbwa, amalaghɨniye i dage weŋgo iŋa, ‘The lolo ne u thuweya Nyao i nja na i yakuwe, iyena iya ne i bapɨtaisoŋgiya gharɨgharɨ e Nyao Boboma.’
Kaerova ya thuwe na ya dage weŋga na yaŋa iye Loi Nariye.”
Jisas gharaghambu va i tuthikaiŋgi
Mbaŋambaŋa vena Jon va mbowo inava gheko i ndeghathɨ weiyaŋgiya gharaghambu theghewo.
Mbaŋa i thuwe Jisas i loŋga valawe ghamwanji, mbe i njimbukiki vara, amba iŋa, “Wo hu thuwe, iyako Loi le Sip Nariye.”
Mbaŋa gharaghambu theghewoma thɨ loŋwe iyake, kaero thɨ ghambugha Jisas.
Jisas i ndevɨ na i thuweŋgi thɨ rereghambawe, i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Nuwamiya budakai?” Thɨŋa, “Rabai (gharumwaru Ravavaghare), aŋga u yaku?”
I gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Hu mena hu thuwe.” Amba thɨ wa weinji na vethɨ thuwe aŋga i yaku, na vethɨ yaku weinji e mbaŋako iyako tɨne, kaiwae mbaŋa vamba ŋgoreiye po klok.
Gharɨgharɨke iya thenjighewoke iyava thɨ loŋwe Jon ghalɨŋae, regha idae Endru, Saimon Pita ghaghae na thɨ rereghambawe Jisas.
I viva moli, Endru i vaidikaiya ghaghae Saimon na i dagewe iŋa, “Kaero mo vaidiya Mesaiya” (gharumwaru Krais).
Amba i vaŋgumenawe Jisas. Jisas i thuwe na i dagewe iŋa, “Ghen Saimon, rama idae Jon. Ghen ne idan Sipas.” (Idake iyake ŋgoreiya Pita, gharumwaru “varɨ.”)
Jisas i kula weŋgiya Pilip na Nataniyel
Mbaŋambaŋa vena Jisas nuwaiya i wa Galili ele valɨvaŋga. Ko amba muyai i wa gheko i lavolevoleya Pilip na i dagewe iŋa, “U ghambuŋgo.”
Pilip iye ŋgoreiya Endru na Pita ghambanji regha, Betɨsaida.

Pilip i vaidiya Nataniyel na i dagewe iŋa, “Kaero wo vaidiya loloma iya Mosese va i roriya utuniyema Mbaro e gha Buk tɨne na Loi ghalɨŋae gharautu vambe thɨ rororiva kaiwae. Iye Jisas, Josep nariye, i mena Nasaret.”
Nataniyel i vaito iŋa, “Nasaret! Mbene bigi thovuye regha i mena gheko?” Pilip iŋa, “U mena u thuwe.”
Mbaŋa Jisas i thuwe Nataniyel amba i menamenako kaero i utuŋa utuniye iŋa, “Loloke iyake Isirel ŋgamaniye moli. Ma mbaŋa regha i utu kwan.”
Nataniyel i vaito iŋa, “Ŋgoroŋga uŋa na u ghareghareŋgo?” Jisas i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Ma thuweŋge menan e umbwa idae ‘fig’ raberabe amba muyai Pilip i kula e ghen.”
Nataniyel i dagewe iŋa, “Rabai, ghen Loi Nariye ghen na ghen Isirel lenji Kiŋ!”
Jisas i dagewe iŋa, “U loŋweghathɨ kaiwae ma dage e ghen maŋa ma thuweŋge e umbwa ida fig raberabe. Tene u thuweŋgi bigibigi laghɨlaghɨye na thɨ kivwala iyake!”
Mbowo i dageweva iŋa, “Ya dage emunjoru e ghemi, ne hu thuwe buruburu i mavu na Loi le nyao thovuthovuye thɨ rakavoro na thɨ rakanjawe Lolo Nariye.”
